title: Reflexivity outside two intervals
statement: For any integer-valued sequence $\mu$ and natural numbers $a,n,b,m$, the sequence agrees with itself at every index that is either less than $a$ or at least $a+n$, and also either less than $b$ or at least $b+m$.
